profile.name: USB-TMC实验光源
profile.description: 通过 USB-TMC 通信控制的实验室光源，可进行开关、光强设定、运行时长设定、状态查询、温度读取和预设配方激活，适用于实验中的照明、激发或定时曝光场景。
profile.description_en: A laboratory light source controlled over USB-TMC communication, supporting on/off control, intensity setting, runtime setting, status queries, temperature readout, and preset recipe activation for lab illumination, excitation, or timed exposure tasks.
